purpose: Battery voltage units, calibration write ownership, controlled load response and counter epoch qualification

voltage_units.battery_inputs: Standard IIO millivolts; absolute values use FRACTIONAL/1000, ratiometric values already millivolts

configuration_diagnostic.protected_trim_primary_0x3600: PASS with changed trim and matching primary/companion readbacks
configuration_diagnostic.mirror_0x3800_write: FAIL I/O error; exact original configuration restored; failed stage was not bus-traced

isolated_experiments.sense_only: Manual IADC stayed about17.9mA in the observed USB-powered idle window
isolated_experiments.sense_and_trim: Manual IADC near0mA; refreshing cache alone did not explain the observed low current
isolated_experiments.added_2ms_conversion_delay: No useful change; diagnostic-only hypothesis rejected, not in Linux candidate
isolated_experiments.scope: These USB-powered observations do not establish absolute current; supply can carry system load.

bounded_load.CPU_load: One sha256sum worker, systemd RuntimeMaxSec18 and CPUAccounting; approximately18CPU-seconds observed
bounded_load.safety_guard: Stop load if thermistor voltage falls below630mV; charger protections unchanged
bounded_load.load_at_500mA: Manual near0 battery current, no BMS sense transition observed; does not establish sensor failure
bounded_load.load_at_100mA: Manual current responds around-0.20..-0.24A; independent battery voltage falls about30mV; BMS sense and counters respond with opposite sign

derived_final_samples.source: Vendor CC/VSENSE gain/time conversion; compensation omitted
derived_final_samples.scope: Load response and provisional conversion consistency only; no external accuracy or capacity qualification

bounded_load.qualification: Cross-path load response and provisional conversion consistency. Both current paths share calibration/sense hardware; not external accuracy, idle/charging accuracy, temperature compensation or capacity qualification.

counter_epoch.sequence: Assert clear bits7/6 at0x4043, wait100us, force deassertion; bounded retry and readback
counter_epoch.optimized_update_attempt: FAIL acceptance: counters already flat before, and remain flat through restart and load despite zero command readback
counter_epoch.regmap_skip_inference: Source inspection and the read-zero command model show an optimized update can skip deassertion. No bus-write trace was captured. Forced writes recover counting on hardware.
counter_epoch.forced_writes: PASS: main and shadow counters change during configured idle, 100mA load and afterward
counter_epoch.host_negative_regression: Replacing forced epoch writes with optimized updates fails the latched-disable regression

current_convention: BMS VSENSE/CC have opposite sign to manual IADC during the established discharge window. Invert for positive-charging CURRENT_NOW and matching relative charge integration.
